This week on StrictlyVC Download, TechCrunch
Editor-in-Chief Connie Loizos and Alex Gove of
StrictlyVC speak with Dimitrios Kottas, the
founder and CEO of Delian Alliance Industries.
They discuss his journey from Apple’s Special
Projects Group to building autonomous defense
systems in Greece; how his company is
reimagining surveillance and strike capabilities
using AI and commercial tech; and why he thinks
we’re at the start of a decade-long technological
race in the next generation of warfare.
StrictlyVC Download posts every Tuesday.
Subscribe on Apple, Spotify, or wherever you
listen to podcasts to be alerted when new
episodes drop.
